rows.capability: All 26 explicitly registered launch flags; help/version/info and completion
rows.difference: F05 stage 1 implements local inspection, policy, presentation and initial help/quit; C01 implements kubeconfig/context/namespace/timeout flags. Remaining connection overrides, refresh, resource-command integration and completion remain planned.

rows.capability: Context/kubeconfig/cluster/user/namespace selection and connection overrides
rows.difference: C01 implements read-only kubeconfig merging, explicit per-context SDK sessions, context/namespace selection and timeout states. Cluster/user/credential/TLS CLI overrides remain F05/C08. See docs/context-sessions.md for tested behavior and limits.

rows.capability: AWS EKS, Azure AKS, GKE and generic exec/OIDC/cert/token credentials
rows.difference: C01 qualifies static token/token-file, static embedded/file certificates and synthetic noninteractive exec-token contracts. EKS/AKS/GKE, interactive helpers, legacy providers and exec certificate rotation remain C06/C07/C08; no real-cloud compatibility claim.

rows.capability: TLS/CA/client certificates, proxy, request timeout and impersonation
rows.difference: C01 tests native kubeconfig TLS/CA/client certificates and request deadlines. Native proxies are explicit; proxy/provider qualification and CLI overrides/impersonation remain F05/C08/O04.

rows.capability: Context rename/delete and persisted per-context view/namespace preferences
rows.difference: C01 ordinary context/scope switching never rewrites kubeconfig. Persisted per-context view preferences and explicit rename/delete remain F03/M08.

rows.capability: API discovery, resource aliases and dynamic/CRD server columns
rows.difference: C02 implements discovery, backend aliases and consistent scoped snapshots. Dynamic/CRD columns and UI resource integration remain planned in the existing tasks; this does not establish full CORE01 parity.

rows.capability: Live resource updates, manual refresh, retry/reconnect and errors
rows.difference: C03 implements backend list/watch updates and recovery. C04 connects one active generation-bound pod view, bounded subscriptions, scope cancellation and visible live/stale/error counts. Preview correction #107 keeps quiet renewals live, bounds failed streams and clarifies loading/count/shortcut status. Table rows/manual refresh remain B02/F05; complete CORE02 parity is still planned.
